text:
leela: Heads-up — PR #4241 (sdk snippets migration) is stuck in docs CI. Linkcheck + Vale errors. We need a merge slot before tomorrow's patch release.
ci-bot: CI failed: linkcheck (2 failures), vale (style errors). Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/4241
ash: I can take the linkcheck fix. Looks like two broken links in examples dir.
max: which files? I can push a quick commit if you want. trying to free up time later today.
ash: files: `docs/sdk/python/examples/quickstart.md` and `docs/guides/migration.md` — both have relative links that don't resolve after rearrange.
kai: I ran `scripts/linkcheck.sh` locally — output below:
```
docs/sdk/python/examples/quickstart.md: broken link to ../reference/client.md
docs/guides/migration.md: broken link to /docs/old-auth.md
```
jen: vale errors are mostly passive-voice and wording in migration guide. I'll prepare a small wording PR to address the rules.
leela: Can we coordinate reviewers? We need 1 tech + 1 docs approver. Prefer merge window at 16:30 PT. If not merged, risk blocking the nightly.
max: I can be tech reviewer around 16:15. @kai can you be docs approver? you reviewed last week.
kai: yup I can review at 16:20. Will check the preview once fixes are pushed.
ash: pushing linkfix commit now — tiny change to two relative paths. Pushing as `ash/docs/linkfix-4241`
ci-bot: New preview available: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/4241/ash-docs-linkfix-4241 — linkcheck passed, vale still failing (3 notices)
jen: vale notices are mostly for headings and contractions. I'll open a follow-up PR with wording + heading tweaks and mark as docs-only.
leela: OK — plan: merge linkfix first (no code change), tag `release-blocker` and then jen's wording PR can be merged separately if CI clears. Can someone add the label and queue for 16:30 slot?
max: added label `merge/16:30-release` and draft a short changelog entry. I'll queue the merge.
kai: quick pass done. LGTM on link fixes. No content regressions.
leela: thanks. if CI passes on the linkfix preview, i'll request merge at 16:30. jen, ping here when your PR is ready and I'll check vale again.
jen: will do. ETA ~30m.
leela: great — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
